picks.why: the city below its castle hill with the dome of the New Cathedral

picks.file: Panorama di Brescia SO dalla Via Panoramica.jpg
picks.what: The old town and the New Cathedral from the Via Panoramica, photograph
picks.why: sharp high view over the old town’s rooftops with the cathedral dome

notes: #1 and #2 are a Nuremberg Chronicle portrait of Bartholomew of Brescia, not a city view. #3 is a fish-market print (after Snyders, Houghton Hall) held in a Brescia museum, not Brescia. #4 (1897) shows only the monumental cemetery. #6, #8, #10 and #11 are weaker modern views (mostly greenery, suburbs or the newer town).
